Subject: Post-discovery: demo window proposal + SME nominees

Hi Tom & Lina,

Thanks again for the call earlier — really helpful to understand Kestrel's current latency constraints and the evaluation criteria you called out (token-cost, cold-starts, and SSO). As discussed, the best next step is a short, focused 30-minute product intro where we:

- Walk through a tailored 10–12 slide deck showing Redwood in a workload similar to yours
- Demo a quick live run with 1–2 representative prompts (low-latency path + batching demo)
- Confirm success criteria and next steps for a technical deep dive (if useful)

Proposed windows (all times PT):
1) Wed, Sep 15 — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Thu, Sep 16 — 14:30–15:00 PT
3) Mon, Sep 20 — 09:00–09:30 PT

Please pick your top 2 options (or suggest alternatives) and let us know who from your side should join. For context, we recommend these attendees:
- From Kestrel: a product/PM owner + an infra/ops person (to confirm throughput/latency expectations)
- From Redwood: Nikhil (pre-sales) + Marissa (solutions engineer / SME) — listed below.

Quick asks / prep we can handle before the session:
- I attached an updated mutual action plan with proposed milestones (mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx).
- If you have any 'must-test' prompts or a short sample payload, please drop it into the pre-demo questions doc (pre-demo-questions.md) or reply inline.

Attendees from our side:
- Nikhil Sharma — Account Executive, Redwood Inference — nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
- Marissa Cole — Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference — marissa.cole@redwood.com

If you want, I can lock one of the slots and send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
